business_problem: The USTA needed to turn massive volumes of live tennis and fan-interaction data into resilient, personalized digital experiences for millions of US Open viewers, while handling traffic spikes, keeping infrastructure highly available, and giving editors and fans real-time insights throughout the tournament.
solution_summary: IBM and the USTA built the US Open digital platform on a hybrid multicloud architecture that combines Red Hat OpenShift for portable application deployment, watsonx.data as a lakehouse for AI-ready data management, and automated IT operations to keep the event responsive under extreme demand. Match play generates more than 800 data points per point and over 1.2 billion data points across a tournament, so IBM routes and manages those event streams, centralizes structured and unstructured data, and applies AI to transform raw feeds into fan-facing features and insights. Applications can run across multiple clouds without being rewritten, while Terraform-driven provisioning reduces manual build work and improves consistency. This stack lets the USTA introduce new capabilities quickly, keep uptime at five-nines during tournament play, and scale personalized content, real-time analysis, and digital storytelling to a global audience.

solution_components.name: Red Hat OpenShift Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the container platform so US Open applications can run consistently across multiple clouds.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.data
solution_components.role: Centralizes structured and unstructured tournament data for AI workloads and real-time fan insights.

solution_components.name: Terraform
solution_components.role: Automates infrastructure provisioning for the UI and data services that power digital experiences during the tournament.

data_flow: Live match telemetry and digital engagement data are collected continuously, routed into the US Open data estate, curated in watsonx.data, and then served through OpenShift-hosted applications and AI experiences that surface insights to editors, broadcasters, and fans in real time.
business_outcome: The USTA delivers world-class digital experiences to more than 14 million fans, keeps the platform available during traffic spikes above 5,000%, and uses automated operations plus AI-powered insights to support faster publishing, richer storytelling, and resilient digital engagement during the US Open.
